fields.description: Employee rings their Cell Number. Softphone User rings that person's desk/browser softphone. Phone Number rings any number you type, for someone with no Employee record or a line that is not a person. Account Manager rings whoever owns the calling customer's account, resolved per call. Voicemail takes a message instead of ringing anyone, and is exclusive — a rule that sends callers to voicemail cannot also ring phones.
